# NEW 2026-11-24 v26.0 WP11 Full Roman Empire Theme System Expansion (4 Praetorian Prefectures + 79 Regions + E01-E10).
# Generated by gen_v260_theme_empire.py from data/oe_theme_regions_empire.json; edit the SSOT/generator, not this file.

# Per-Prefecture 1-Click Founding: P1 东方近卫大区 (Praetorian Prefecture of the East)
oe_theme_found_prefecture_1_action = {
    type = internationalorganization
    show_message = no
    potential = {
        scope:actor = { oe_is_phoenix_empire = yes }
    }
    allow = {
        scope:actor = {
            at_war = no
            has_raised_levies = no
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_theme_found_pref_1_none_tt oe_theme_pref_any_creatable_1 = yes }
        }
        international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars ?= {
            custom_tooltip = { text = OE_PILLARS_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED_5 var:oe_pillars_authority >= 5 }
        }
    }
    automation_tick = never
    ai_tick = never
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = international_organization
        source = actor
        target_flag = recipient
        name = "choose_international_organization"
        none_available_msg_key = "leave_international_organization_none"
        column = { data = name }
        visible = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars this = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars scope:actor = { oe_is_phoenix_empire = yes } }
    }
    effect = {
        scope:actor = {
            custom_tooltip = oe_theme_found_pref_1_tt
            hidden_effect = {
                oe_theme_found_prefecture = { pref = 1 cost = 5 }
                trigger_event_non_silently = oe_theme_empire.1
            }
        }
    }
}

# Prefecture Expansion Theme Charter: P1 东方近卫大区 (15 Authority, independent unlock)
oe_theme_unlock_prefecture_1_action = {
    type = internationalorganization
    show_message = no
    potential = {
        scope:actor = {
            oe_is_phoenix_empire = yes
            oe_theme_pref_charter_eligible_1 = yes
        }
    }
    allow = {
        scope:actor = {
            oe_is_phoenix_empire = yes
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_theme_unlock_pref_1_elig_tt oe_theme_pref_charter_eligible_1 = yes }
        }
        international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars ?= {
            custom_tooltip = { text = OE_THEME_EMP_AUTH_15 var:oe_pillars_authority >= 15 }
        }
    }
    automation_tick = never
    ai_tick = never
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = international_organization
        source = actor
        target_flag = recipient
        name = "choose_international_organization"
        none_available_msg_key = "leave_international_organization_none"
        column = { data = name }
        visible = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars this = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars scope:actor = { oe_is_phoenix_empire = yes } }
    }
    effect = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                scope:actor = { oe_is_phoenix_empire = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_pref_1_charter } }
                exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars
                international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars ?= { var:oe_pillars_authority >= 15 }
            }
            international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = -15 } }
            scope:actor = {
                custom_tooltip = {
                    text = oe_theme_unlock_pref_1_tt
                    set_variable = oe_theme_pref_1_charter
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

# Eastern Exarchate Grand Theme Consolidation (E01-E10: collapses 38 medieval Eastern themes into 10 Grand Themes)
oe_theme_consolidate_exarchates_action = {
    type = internationalorganization
    show_message = no
    potential = {
        scope:actor = { oe_is_phoenix_empire = yes }
    }
    allow = {
        scope:actor = {
            at_war = no
            has_raised_levies = no
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_theme_exarchate_unlock_tt OR = { oe_prf_tier_1_ok = yes oe_prf_has_active_prefecture = yes oe_theme_any_exarchate_ready = yes } }
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_theme_exarchate_ready_tt oe_theme_any_exarchate_ready = yes }
        }
        international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars ?= {
            custom_tooltip = { text = OE_PILLARS_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED_5 var:oe_pillars_authority >= 5 }
        }
    }
    automation_tick = never
    ai_tick = never
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = international_organization
        source = actor
        target_flag = recipient
        name = "choose_international_organization"
        none_available_msg_key = "leave_international_organization_none"
        column = { data = name }
        visible = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars this = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars scope:actor = { oe_is_phoenix_empire = yes } }
    }
    effect = {
        scope:actor = {
            custom_tooltip = oe_theme_consolidate_exarchates_tt
            hidden_effect = {
                trigger_event_non_silently = oe_theme_empire.2
            }
        }
    }
}
